entities.name: Florin Ozbolt
entities.description: A former Simic scientist who turned himself into the ooze creature Experiment One.

entities.name: Liana
entities.description: A young researcher who became Florin's apprentice.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: The guild whose new law governs the experiments.

events.summary: Liana visits Florin's lab and becomes his apprentice.
events.quote: he accepted her as his apprentice.

events.summary: Florin and Liana develop a limb-replacement therapy using a mimetic ooze on injured rats.
events.quote: The pair spent their first time together working on an innovative limb-replacement therapy, using injured rats to test results.

events.summary: Florin argues for experimenting on oneself and asks if Liana is ready; she reluctantly agrees.
events.quote: Florin asked Liana if she was ready for such a thing, and she reluctantly agreed.

events.summary: A rat's ooze-graft grows, and Florin announces he is ready for Experiment One.
events.quote: The scientist was now ready to proceed with the cryptic test that he called Experiment One .

events.summary: Liana finds the lab abandoned and the ooze in the tank moving; it launches out of the vat.
events.quote: Suddenly, the ooze launched itself out of the vat, and Liana jumped back, shouting for her master.

events.summary: The ooze is revealed to have taken Florin's shape; he has transformed himself.
events.quote: The ooze had taken Florin's shape, just as it had taken the shape of the rats' missing limbs.

events.summary: Florin tells Liana he has bettered himself and that humanity's real problem is its frail organs.
events.quote: he told her he had bettered himself, just as they had spoken of in their debates.

events.summary: Florin urges Liana to enter the vat; she flees.
events.quote: but she turned and ran, out of the lab and beyond, and she did not look back.

relations.quote: he accepted her as his apprentice.
Satisfied, Florin permitted Liana to go see her love interest Jovan.
